scope: Normal detector rerun on JPEG recording; rows contain no external traffic identity or score annotations. Box timestamps follow normal 5 Hz cadence, association uses the current native range snapshot and both ego poses. Ground-plane ray is an independent, sometimes biased box-bottom estimate. Only raw=true rows with a non-null source_vehicle are positive witnesses. Missing raw data is unobserved. Rigid-board control uses retained original empty detector observations.
